verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents a public API with personal-token and OAuth2 auth, programmatic task, view, comment and attachment management, an interactive "Try It" panel on every endpoint, a versioned OpenAPI spec, and a live llms.txt. The probe's 404s at guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the docs, which say the spec is published per API version. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Build integrations and apps with our Public API.
Using the ClickUp API, you can create, update, and manage tasks programmatically.
You can create, update, delete, group, sort, and filter views at any level of the ClickUp hierarchy using the API.
The raw OpenAPI specification for the ClickUp API is available for each version of our Public API.
Use a personal API token for individual or testing purposes.
